questions.explanation: Cardinal marks are black and yellow. Their topmarks are two black cones.

questions.stem: You should pass a north cardinal mark on its:
questions.explanation: Pass a north cardinal on its north side: the safe water lies to the north of it.

questions.stem: You should pass a south cardinal mark on its:
questions.explanation: Pass a south cardinal on its south side: the safe water lies to the south of it.

options: Yellow with a yellow X topmark
Black with red bands and two black balls
Green with a green cone topmark
Red and white vertical stripes with a red ball on top
questions.explanation: An isolated danger mark is black with red bands and has two black balls on top. It sits on a small danger with safe water all round, so pass well clear.

questions.stem: A red and white vertically striped buoy means:
questions.explanation: Red and white vertical stripes mean safe water all round. It is often a fairway or mid-channel mark.

options: Special areas such as cables or anchorages
Fishing nets set by commercial boats in the season
The edges of a dredged channel
questions.explanation: Yellow buoys are special marks, for things like cables, outfalls or anchorages. Check the chart for what each one marks.

questions.stem: A boat with divers in the water displays:
questions.explanation: A boat with divers down flies flag Alpha, a blue and white swallowtail. Keep well clear and slow down.

options: A blue and white swallowtail flag only, on the boat
A yellow flag with a black ball
A red flag with a white diagonal stripe
A green flag with a white cross
questions.explanation: Divers in the water are marked by a red flag with a white diagonal stripe. Slow down and keep clear.

questions.stem: A mark with two cones pointing down is the:
questions.explanation: Two cones pointing down is a south cardinal. A north cardinal has both cones pointing up.

questions.stem: A mark with horizontal red and green bands marks:
options: A wreck with clear water above
questions.explanation: Horizontal red and green bands mark a channel junction. The colour of the top band shows the preferred channel; check the chart.
